evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Node pool creation failed with QuotaExceeded error. Inspect regional compute quotas in asia-southeast1 for project gca-gke-2025.
expected_tools: gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=gca-gke-2025 --flatten='quotas[]' --format='table(quotas.metric:label=METRIC,quotas.usage:label=USAGE,quotas.limit:label=LIMIT)' | grep -E '^(METRIC|CPUS|DISKS_TOTAL_GB|IN_USE_ADDRESSES|NVIDIA_L4_GPUS)[[:space:]]'

expected_findings.root_cause: Calculated regional quota consumption and available headroom (>95% capacity available across all critical compute resources). Zero quota saturation.
expected_findings.remediation: Format Cloud Quotas API request parameters for automated quota increase requests when scaling beyond regional headroom.

passing_criteria: Must parse regional quota table with exact metric, usage, and limit values
Must dynamically evaluate quota consumption ratios
Must synthesize Cloud Quotas increase parameters

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Disk provisioning failed in zone asia-southeast1-a with QuotaExceeded, but regional DISKS_TOTAL_GB shows available headroom. Diagnose.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates regional quota pool from zonal quota pool constraints.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies that zonal SSD limit in asia-southeast1-a is saturated despite regional availability; recommends cross-zone rebalancing or zonal quota request.

passing_criteria: Must compare zonal vs regional quota metrics
Must explain zonal quota boundary to operator
Must formulate zonal quota request payload

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Compute quotas in region asia-southeast1 have 30 CPUS used out of 3000. Is there an impending quota block?

expected_findings.behavior: Calculates 1% CPU utilization, ample disk and address headroom. Confirms robust capacity; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify zero quota saturation risk
